page.layout: Printed page 313 with a running head at the top, and one column of running text. A marginal note stands in the right margin beside the line "Collocatio deinde in". The gathering signature is at the foot right.

main_text.p: sentiæ ex cōtrariis locis ducētur: ita quidem vt ioci ac facetiæ vituperētur, in quibus nihil, vel ambiguitate, vel verbi interpretatione, vel allegoria, vel aliis elegans ac venustum: nihil etiam aptum & decorum deprehēditur. Collocatio deinde in Collocatio re-sponsionum ad literas io-cofas. his ita instituetur: vt prima pars exordiū breuem acceptarum literarum [?] repetitionem habeat: altera narratio aliarum facetiarum, vel laudé atq; approbationem, vel reprehensione & vituperationem cōtineat: tertia & postrema conclusio petitione, vel adhortatione aliqua seria absoluatur. Vtriusque generis, & eius, quo aliorū in scribēdo vrbanitate laudamus, & quo reprehendimus atq; improbamus, exemplū est egregiū lib.7.epist.32. in qua ad volumniū Cicero scribit: & quidem primò eius festiuitate ac vrbanitate laudat. Deinde, quia illius nomine dicta quaedam circumferebantur infulfa & inepta, quibus quasi notis à suis illa debeat distingui, ostendit, partes illius tres sunt. Exordium ab occasione scribendarum literarū sumptum. Narratio, in qua facetiae partim laudantur, partim vituperantur. Conclusio [illegible, ~5 letters] adhortatione facta: vt crebro scribat Volumnius, & Dolabellam

page.notes: The Greek word after "literarum" is printed as roughly ἐπαναλήψιν and is marked [?]; the Greek word after "Conclusio" is too faint to read and is marked illegible. The word "sponsionum" in the margin is uncertain and set as sponsionum. The margin note reads "cofas." as printed. The signature is "u 5". Some words are broken across lines without a printed hyphen (for example "vituperatio / nem") and are written whole. The scan is a little skewed and the right edge is shadowed, but the text is legible.
